name: com.puzzlecraftgames.adsiapkit
description:
One API for mobile ads and in-app purchases. Switch between AdMob, Unity Ads, IronSource and AppLovin MAX from a setup window that installs the SDKs and mediation adapters for you, with Unity IAP 5, a product catalog editor, a ready-made shop UI, Google UMP consent and iOS App Tracking Transparency built in.

Ad and IAP SDKs are optional: install only the ones you use.

samples.description: A drop-in script with buttons for banner, interstitial, rewarded ads, purchases, restore and privacy options.
